newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - May 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - May 13.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Arabia's cabinet agreed on security cooperation measures with Yemen.
- Saudi businessmen are to set up an information net through the internet at a cost of $18 million.
- Qatar's crown prince laid the foundation stone of the new $3.4 billion Rasgas project.
- Kuwait confirmed the release of five Iraqis who tried to enter the country illegally.
- Gulf Arab states receive 75 percent of British exports to Arab countries.
- Iraq's oil minister said Iraqi ports were capable of handling six million barrels of oil per day.
